name: Fujimino Isao
source:
Juan Corrida was a young action star who starred as the titular character in the Worldwide Studios show The Jammin' Ninja. He had a fierce rivalry with actor Matt Engarde, star of the Global Studios show The Nickel Samurai. He is the victim of the "Farewell, My Turnabout" case.

[SPOILER]
Two years before his death, Corrida met Celeste Inpax and took her as his manager. The two quickly fell in love and became engaged. However, Engarde came told Corrida that Inpax was his former lover. Outraged by this revelation, Corrida called off his wedding with Inpax, resulting in her suicide.

When Corrida found the dead Inpax, he forged a suicide note and kept it in his person, preparing for an opportunity to ruin Engarde with the note. Corrida began to concoct a plan for revenge against Engarde with Adrian Andrews, who was Engarde's manager and Inpax's protege. Tabloid papers witnessing them together reported that Corrida and Andrews were in a scandalous relationship. 

Two years after Inpax's death, the Jammin' Ninja participated in the third annual Grand Prix, and Corrida's plan to ruin Engarde was set into motion. Corrida had arranged with Andrews to get a Nickel Samurai costume and to call a press conference with the Nickel Samurai, in which Corrida would appear, dressed as the Nickel Samurai and pretending to be Engarde, and "confess" to Engarde's manipulation of Inpax.

However, Engarde had a plan of his own to get Inpax's will back from Corrida. He hired an assassin, Shelly de Killer, to kill Corrida in his room. After a struggle, de Killer managed to strangle Corrida with a scarf.
[/SPOILER]

[Based on his [URL=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Ace_Attorney_Wiki]Ace Attorney Wiki[/URL] page.]
